shortDefinition.en: On an X-T5 with normal half-press operation, autofocus locks while the shutter button is held halfway.
shortDefinition.zh-cn: 在 X-T5 正常半按快门操作时，自动对焦在半按保持期间锁定。

en: AF-S behavior can be changed by lens switches, button customization, and options such as Pre-AF.
zh-cn: 镜头开关、自定义按键和 Pre-AF 等选项会改变 AF-S 的细节行为。

example.en: Use AF-S as a starting point for a stationary building, with the focus point on the intended surface.
example.zh-cn: 拍摄静止建筑时可从 AF-S 开始，并把对焦点放在目标表面上。

sources.title: Autofocus — FUJIFILM X-T5 Owner’s Manual
sources.supports: Single-AF focus locking and its intended use for stationary subjects.
